Great to be moving forward. We want to lock in the POC kickoff so your engineering, security and procurement partners can align on scope, timeline and success criteria. Proposed objectives for the first session:

- Confirm technical success criteria (latency, throughput, dataset boundaries)
- Validate network and data access requirements (VPC, sample data, KMS)

Availability options: Apr 14 (10:00–11:00 PT), Apr 15 (13:00–14:00 PT) or Apr 19 (09:00–10:00 PT). If none of these work, please share a couple windows that suit your engineers + security + procurement and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks everyone — locking final details.

Confirmed kickoff: Apr 19, 2027 09:00–10:00 PT (Google Meet link below).
Owners & attendees:
- EverFin: Priya Rao (Head of Data Platforms), Ankit Shah (SWE), procurement rep (procurement@everfin.com)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, owner), Diego Fernandez (SE, technical lead), Dylan Brooks (Customer Success, program owner), Laura Bennett (Product, escalation), Hannah Schmitt (Sales Ops, logistics)

Success criteria for the 4-week POC (summary):
1) Technical validation: <100ms median inference latency on the sample dataset at the agreed concurrency profile.
2) Integration: API integration completed and initial end-to-end inference run with captured logs.
3) Security & compliance: network connectivity confirmed (VPC egress or peering as agreed) and baseline SOC controls verified.
4) Business: mutual agreement on next-step commercial terms or pilot extension decision.

Attachments: MutualActionPlan.xlsx (owners, milestones, and dates), SOC2_v2.pdf (security snapshot).

Logistics: Marissa will send a calendar invite with agenda and the Meet link; Diego and I will send the environment checklist and pre-kickoff playbook 48 hours before the meeting.

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rwi-everfin-poc

If anything changes on your side, ping Hannah (hannah.schmitt@redwood.com) to reschedule.

Looking forward —
